question: What is Claude AI?
title: What is Claude AI? | BrandBizkit
description:
Understanding the basics of Claude AI by Anthropic. What it is, what it can do, and how it works.
Explore the revolutionary AI technology that's transforming how we interact with machines and access information
paragraphs: Claude is an AI assistant created by Anthropic, designed using a novel approach called Constitutional AI. This method trains AI systems to better align with human values by following a set of principles or a "constitution."

Unlike traditional AI models, Claude is specifically trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest. It aims to provide reliable information while avoiding harmful outputs and maintaining transparency about its limitations.
Claude excels at thoughtful dialogue, complex reasoning, creative writing, and detailed analysis across a wide range of topics, making it a powerful tool for both individuals and businesses.

We can help you get started using Claude AI and other related AI tools. If you already are a user of Claude we can also help you level up your game, teach you new ways of using AI and enhance your output and productivity with super efficient prompts. capabilities.heading: What Can Claude Do?
capabilities.sub: A quick look at what's actually in Claude today — this gets re-checked regularly as Anthropic ships updates.

items.title: Claude Code
items.text: Anthropic's agentic coding tool works in your terminal, desktop app or IDE — it reads files, runs commands, edits code and calls external tools on a real project.

items.title: Artifacts
items.text: Ask Claude to build something and it opens in a live side panel — React components, interactive web apps, diagrams and functional tools you can keep iterating on.

items.title: Projects
items.text: Give a Project its own files, instructions and memory so Claude actually knows the context of a specific client, brand or piece of ongoing work.

items.title: Connect Your Tools (MCP)
items.text: Model Context Protocol connects Claude directly to Gmail, GitHub, Google Drive, Slack and databases, so it can act on real data instead of just discussing it.

items.title: Computer Use
items.text: Claude can operate a graphical interface directly — reading the screen, moving the mouse, typing and clicking through multi-step tasks.

items.title: Long-Document Reasoning
items.text: A large context window and careful, thorough answers make it the strongest pick for reviewing contracts, business plans or lengthy research.
